title: Ohana Fishing Charters
specs: Access to deep drop-offs and fish aggregating devices near Kauai's coast
Year-round world-class fishing with seasonal species like Yellowfin Tuna, Mahi Mahi, Ono, and Striped Marlin
Experienced captains and crew providing personal instruction and safety
No fishing license required for guests; covered by commercial marine license
Not recommended for pregnant women or persons with neck or back problems
Motion sickness medication recommended the night before and morning of trip
No experience needed; crew provides instruction
Standard shared charters host up to 6 passengers
Deluxe shared charters host up to 4 passengers
Private charters available for couples or groups
includes: Professional fishing tackle and gear including rods, reels, lures, outriggers
Fish cleaning, filleting, and bagging for guests

addons.name: Deluxe Share Trip - Up to 4 Passengers

blurb: Guests join guided deep sea fishing charters departing from Nawiliwili Harbor in Lihue, Kauai. Trips include all fishing gear, tackle, and non-alcoholic beverages, with an experienced crew providing instruction and handling rigging. Guests share the catch, which is cleaned and filleted for them to take home.
extraNote: 72-hour cancellation policy · If weather is unsafe, captain may reschedule or cancel trip · Nawiliwili Harbor, Lihue, Kauai
